question: For cameras in Fujifilm's X-T line (single digits only, i.e. not the X-T10, X-T100 etc.) released before 2019, provide a list of model numbers for the Toshiba and SanDisk memory cards that are compatible with ALL of the cameras according to the fujifilm-x.com website. Put the results in a table for me, ordered by the size of the memory card and then the model number.

SanDisk - 64G - SDSDXPB-064G
Toshiba - 64G - SDXU-B064G

answer:
Based on my research of the fujifilm-x.com compatibility pages for all three single-digit X-T cameras released before 2019 (X-T1, X-T2, and X-T3), here are the Toshiba and SanDisk memory cards that are compatible with ALL of them:

| Size | Brand | Series | Model Number |
|------|-------|--------|--------------|
| 16 GB | SanDisk | Extreme PRO | SDSDXPB-016G |
| 16 GB | Toshiba | EXCERIA PRO | SDXU-B016G |
| 32 GB | SanDisk | Extreme PRO | SDSDXPB-032G |
| 32 GB | Toshiba | EXCERIA PRO | SDXU-B032G |
| 64 GB | SanDisk | Extreme PRO | SDSDXPB-064G |
| 64 GB | Toshiba | EXCERIA PRO | SDXU-B064G |

These six memory card models were confirmed on the official Fujifilm compatibility pages for:
- **X-T1** (released 2014)
- **X-T2** (released 2016)
- **X-T3** (released 2018)

All cards work with UHS-I speed class 3 or higher for HD movie recording, and use of UHS-II cards is also supported for high-speed burst photography.

Based on the information gathered from fujifilm-x.com, I need to find Toshiba and SanDisk memory cards that are compatible with ALL of the Fujifilm X-T line cameras released before 2019 (which includes: X-T1, X-T2, X-T3).

From the search results:
- **X-T1**: Toshiba EXCERIA PRO (16GB, 32GB, 64GB) and SanDisk Extreme PRO (16GB, 32GB, 64GB)
- **X-T2**: Toshiba EXCERIA PRO (16GB, 32GB, 64GB) and SanDisk Extreme PRO (16GB, 32GB, 64GB)
- **X-T3**: Toshiba EXCERIA PRO (16GB, 32GB, 64GB) and SanDisk Extreme PRO (16GB, 32GB, 64GB)

Looking at the tables from all three cameras:

**Toshiba models appearing in all three:**
- SDXU-B016G (16GB)
- SDXU-B032G (32GB)
- SDXU-B064G (64GB)

**SanDisk models appearing in all three:**
- SDSDXPB-016G (16GB)
- SDSDXPB-032G (32GB)
- SDSDXPB-064G (64GB)

Note: The X-T3 also shows additional SanDisk variants with different model numbers (SDSDXDK-32G-ANCIN, etc.) but these appear to be regional/custom versions. The base SanDisk Extreme PRO models (SDSDXPB series) appear consistently across all three cameras.


Now I'll compile the comprehensive table ordered by capacity first, then by model number. At 16GB, the Sandisk card precedes Toshiba alphabetically. For 32GB, same ordering applies. At 64GB, Sandisk again comes before Toshiba alphabetically. This gives me a clean, organized presentation of all compatible cards across the X-T1, X-T2, and X-T3 models.

Based on my research of the fujifilm-x.com compatibility pages for all three single-digit X-T cameras released before 2019 (X-T1, X-T2, and X-T3), here are the Toshiba and SanDisk memory cards that are compatible with ALL of them:

| Size | Brand | Series | Model Number |
|------|-------|--------|--------------|
| 16 GB | SanDisk | Extreme PRO | SDSDXPB-016G |
| 16 GB | Toshiba | EXCERIA PRO | SDXU-B016G |
| 32 GB | SanDisk | Extreme PRO | SDSDXPB-032G |
| 32 GB | Toshiba | EXCERIA PRO | SDXU-B032G |
| 64 GB | SanDisk | Extreme PRO | SDSDXPB-064G |
| 64 GB | Toshiba | EXCERIA PRO | SDXU-B064G |

These six memory card models were confirmed on the official Fujifilm compatibility pages for:
- **X-T1** (released 2014)
- **X-T2** (released 2016)
- **X-T3** (released 2018)

All cards work with UHS-I speed class 3 or higher for HD movie recording, and use of UHS-II cards is also supported for high-speed burst photography.
